steps.content: The war may not be over yet. But by destroying one of its engines, people have carved a moment of respite from hell. A moment for all to breathe.

With the collapse of BR-005, the FAC finally seals the Broken Frontline in time. Bereft of their guiding will, the surviving Apostles fall into disarray. The grueling battle rages for another three days before the lingering threat of the Tide of Ashes is finally purged.
Meanwhile, having razed the last Aurum Secretum stronghold, the DisCorps troops race back to the city to reinforce the final push.

Perhaps shocked by Augustus's pre-battle intimidation, the normally boisterous Rancors have fallen into an unnatural silence. Their quietude is disconcerting, leaving the soldiers feeling oddly hollow, as if a crucial part of their battle spirit has been lost.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: Bring the wounded in! I'll handle the treatment!
Yet after all these years, for the first time, they are left in silence to hear the beating of their own hearts.
Synex prowls the allied camp, a cheerful whistle on her lips as she drinks in the beautiful disarray.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well, that was a spectacular failure... Bravo, everyone! And that's my cue to exit stage. It's been a blast, really, but... so long, suckers!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Maybe I'll pay a visit to little Hella?

When the fire within has burned to ash, one must reflect on the past, and thus, find the strength to move forward. For ruins are not a forever shelter, and the next storm may already be on the horizon.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: And at the final hour, who swoops in to save the day? Nirvana! Those Hypercubes were a masterstroke—flawless logistics! Now that's the mark of a true industry leader. Quinn's inventory? Doesn't even compare!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Consider the past forgotten! I'm going to sing your praises from the rooftops—a personal endorsement from me to the FAC and the West District! They'll see you as the heroes you are!

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: ...Your theatrics this time were disruptive. You've drawn a spotlight on yourself. Sooner or later, you'll be on their radar.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: No one will be there to take the next bullet for you.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Let them look. I've been on someone's radar anyway. If they're brave enough to take a second shot, I'll make sure the world watches it happen.
He looks up with a carefree grin.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Besides, I'm not alone anymore.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: See? Even you're offering me advice. Things are looking up already.
[Transition] (Underground Shelter)

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: We won? For real? Yaaaaaas! Get the good stuff, we gotta— ...Oh, hang on. Wait. No, no, I almost forgot.

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: I'm just... I'm just glad it's over. We can breathe easy. And hey, I ain't celebrating them losing. I know you're from out there, Sibilla. I really hope your people are alright.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...I know. Thank you, Gracelyn.
Time and again, that girl's question echoes in her mind.
[Enter Flashback]

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Sibilla, do you hate DisCity?
Hate? No, never. In her darkest hour, it was the people of DisCity who reached out to her. That truth resonates far louder than any propaganda.
If there is any hatred to be named, the true question for Sibilla is this: "Do you hate Fraser?"

Hate them for their deception, their incitement, their extortion and exploitation. For murder and inhumane sacrifice. The reasons are endless. In the depths of despair, hatred can reignite a cold heart; it is the most raw, the most primal of fires.
...If only such fire could truly end suffering. If only it could forge a better future.

But hate cannot even bring back the truth behind Furor. It cannot build the new path Sibilla must walk. There is no time to dwell in resentment—she must depart, and quickly. After all, she refuses to believe she has lost everything.

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: Ooh, but speaking of—what about that girl you met before? Uh... Jelena, right? The one from Eastside. She's gonna come around again? She's got a friend also called Sable, with roots out your way too, right? That's pretty wild! You should totally hang with her more.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I was actually thinking that myself. I'd like that.
[Sibilla's Flashback]

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: When all of this is over and things get better, would you like to visit again?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: There are quite a few cyborgs living in Syndicate, and Outlanders too. I think you'd like it there.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Thank you. See you next time, then.
[Scene Change]
There is always a price to pay.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: See, this is why we shouldn't judge all Outlanders. I heard we managed to fix the Hypercube shortage, and it was all thanks to Quinn. Apparently, President Eirene had already arranged the supplies and secured the WhiteSands routes right before she was detained. Did us a huge solid!

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: Oh, that's totally true! And get this—the word is she only came here in the first place because her no-good father, Campbell, was trying to have her killed. She's been done with Fraser for years. DisCity's her home now. We're the ones who actually took her in.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: How merciless you are, sister. You placed your wagers on DisCity early—clever, to free yourself from this mire so swiftly. Then... would you be so kind as to retrieve your brother's remains from this foreign land and lay him to rest properly?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, but I jest... You surely don't remember having such a brother.
His laughter dies abruptly, his gaze caught by a poster outside—a photograph of a Fraser commanding officer's aircraft, broken and burning.
Among the victorious crowds, a voice remarks, "He should've just surrendered. Fraser sold him out anyway... What a waste. So young, and he bought into every single lie."

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: ...And here I was... thinking we might celebrate your birthday in DisCity...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: So this is the price...
There is always truth buried beneath.

EDGE-02: BR-005 has been neutralized. As agreed, SHP-13 did not absorb ██ to ensure survival. It's been successfully retrieved by the Ring Research Institute, but it's since lost all activity. For now, it makes an excellent research specimen.

EDGE-07: BR-003 has returned to concealment to recuperate. This proves the technology is still immature. We should halt forced requisitions immediately. If the enemy discovers its weaknesses, its value as a deterrent is gone.

EDGE-02: Then our involvement is concluded. Conventional warfare is outside our jurisdiction. It's time to hand specific operations back to the subordinate agencies.
EDGE-02: This operation has yielded many unexpected outcomes. We'll have our hands full with the ramifications.

EDGE-03: Before that, one point requires clarification.

EDGE-03: ...Reports indicate SHP-13 has expressed an intent to eliminate BR-003. For a subject of high emotional volatility, the statement still represents a genuine position.
EDGE-03: How should we address this declaration?

EDGE-01: He actually said that?
EDGE-01: Then it seems... both we and he need to work against the clock.
steps.female_content:
EDGE-03: ...Reports indicate SHP-13 has expressed an intent to eliminate BR-003. For a subject of high emotional volatility, the statement still represents a genuine position.
EDGE-03: How should we address this declaration?

EDGE-01: She actually said that?
EDGE-01: Then it seems... both we and she need to work against the clock.

steps.content: EDGE-01: Our monitors indicate the Underground Shepherd has begun to mobilize since BR-003's exposure.
There are always scars left by shadows, lasting a lifetime.
[Black Screen] Sound of a trigger being pulled

Elvira slumps in her room at the Bureau, her back against the headboard. The small handgun rests in her limp grip. She pulls the trigger. Click. Again. Click. The empty, mechanical sound hangs in the silent air. And then, slowly, a smile spreads across her face.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Hah... She actually believed I was one of them. That we were the same... Heh... So pathetic. Who even made them this way? Fraser? The Underground?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I will never forget... the ones who blinded them, used them, and sent them all to die... I will never forgive that.
In this age, suffering endures unvanquished; malice still spreads among mankind. Thus, war never truly ends—an eternal cycle, spinning on.

<size=50><color=#dg1f1f><i>Yet there will always be those who march into battle. One after another, they choose their path, defy their fate, and refuse defeat until their final breath.</size></color><i>
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So this is what the shackles are like when they're not contaminated... Hmm. They do feel clean. No more of that sticky, distorted sensation.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You've been carrying this level of contamination while running around with me for over a month? I really did underestimate you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not one of your soldiers.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Heh. Pity. I really did want you in my unit. But it's true that the battlefield's no place for you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Then... thank you, my ally.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You made it back alive. Well done.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Storming a place like that... You really are DisCorps's commander. There's nothing you won't fight—no, nothing you can't win.

The necessary registration is complete. Though BR-005 has been eliminated, the shadow of war from the farlands still lingers. A new chapter of power struggles within the city is already unfolding, and above it all, BR-003 looms.
Your battlefields once overlapped with hers, but that season has passed. Perhaps now is the time to part ways.
—Though in the foreseeable future, like it or not, your paths are destined to cross frequently.
After a moment's thought, you forgo the formal DisCity military salute. Instead, you simply extend your hand.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Go tell them yourself. We'll be waiting at Nirvana Port.
Your hands clasp, tighten briefly, then release.
The commander from bygone days departs with the silenced war drums, leaving you to the future.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You don't get it. It was you who saved the Shattered Blade.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Your survival is the greatest redemption those soldiers could have asked for.
Augustus returns to her troops, to her warriors who have been waiting.
For twelve years, they were specters, reunited with vacant eyes and blood-stained hands. But today, she finally sees it: a glimpse of the people they were always meant to be.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You've done well. You didn't harm the innocent, never retreated in the face of powerful enemies, never blindly followed orders you didn't believe in, and protected everyone you swore to defend.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You became the blade itself—edge aimed at fate, never yielding. Warriors like you are my most treasured weapons. Every moment you fought with your lives on the line shines with irreplaceable glory. This victory remains pure. Untarnished.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Now, return to the world of the living. Then decide your own path.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Property Owner

BR-005 has finally been taken down, yet no new mine has materialized at its point of origin or its final defeat.

This anomaly cannot be explained by the inherent weakness of the Black Ring itself, giving rise to a new theory: the Apostle Black Ring was immensely powerful at its birth but had drastically weakened by the time it reached DisCity's borders.

Vast amounts of its energy were mysteriously dispersed along its trajectory. This suggests the new BR-005 mine could be concentrated somewhere along this path, or that its power has fractured into numerous smaller deposits scattered far and wide. Around this suspicion, new conflicts are already brewing.

Sinner Hella, who escaped the Black Ring, has undergone comprehensive examination and treatment. With the full support of all relevant departments, the Black Ring's corrupting influence on her will eventually be entirely purged.

However, the profound fusion and corruption between Hella and the shackles have permanently altered her Mania characteristics, granting her an unusual aptitude for achieving deep resonance with others.

Her core ability remains self-healing and regeneration. Her exceptional combat prowess, however, appears to be fueled by a residual will of the Black Ring—a silent, watchful presence that now guards her.
[ED]
